Fixes an empty `/desk-asana` pane after updating to 0.49.0 with a task open.

- A task detail opened before the update stays open across `/reload-plugins` but has no rich description, and drawing it threw, so the whole pane went blank. It now shows that detail's plain description, and `↻` reloads it with formatting

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
